S: The patient reports burning on urination for three days with urinary frequency and pressure above the pubic bone. No fever, no back pain, no blood in the urine.
A: Urinary tract infection.
P: Increase daily water intake and begin the prescribed antibiotic course as directed. Return if fever, back pain, or vomiting develops.
